sections.text_helper: Section 52.6 "PKA interrupts" in chapter 52 (Public key accelerator (PKA)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2478.
sections.section_content:
There are four individual maskable interrupt sources generated by the public key
accelerator, signaling the following events:
1. PKA unsupported operation error (OPERRF), see Section52.3.7
2. Access to unmapped address (ADDRERRF), see Section52.3.7
3. PKA RAM access while PKA operation is in progress (RAMERRF), see Section52.3.7
4. PKA end of operation (PROCENDF)
The interrupt sources are connected to the same global interrupt request signal pka_it.
The user can enable or disable above interrupt sources individually by changing the mask
bits in the PKA control register (PKA_CR). Setting the appropriate mask bit to 1 enables the
interrupt. The status of the individual interrupt events can be read from the PKA status
register (PKA_SR), and it is cleared in PKA_CLRFR register.
Table478 gives a summary of the available features.
